selected_source_records.claim: An open draft validates compact packed-RoPE scalar cache bounds per sequence in the CUDA and Ascend wrappers. Lengths [3,5], offset2, cache7 become valid instead of incorrectly requiring10 total packed positions. Existing accepted large-cache scalar calls retain their host fast path; no numerical kernel changes are proposed.
limitations: Authored by Aphelios183, not Nathan Chen. Draft/unmerged at observation; the prospective merge SHA is not a landed commit.

All three PR patches/blob IDs equal the actual-parent-to-head commit inventory. Full rotary ops.py parent/head bytes and patch reconstruction are separately checked; other files are changed patches only.

Source expands the old16 varlen cases with36 valid numerical/gradient/scalar-tensor controls and7 CPU exception/message rejection cases. CPU rejection assertions do not prove invalid-input CUDA or CUDA Graph behavior.

Author reports L40 SM89 105 rotary passes,43 added base-fail/head-pass cases and367 selected dependent passes/38 skips. Supplementary forward graph/XPos/YOCO/inplace coverage is author-reported; no independent upstream execution or raw test logs were inspected.

Eight exact-head workflow records: five successful, one queued and two in progress at02:56. nvidia-h100-ci success is workflow metadata; jobs/logs and actual H100 numerical coverage were not inspected. Author had no local H100/Ascend; torch.compile, graph backward, invalid graph assertions and FlashAttention numerical callers remain unverified.
Supplementary L40 timings had unlocked clocks. Baseline rejects the new compact-cache input, so no speedup, memory saving, SM90+ or end-to-end training benefit is established.
selected_source_records.our_inference: Packed sequence boundaries, offsets and cache extent are part of the numerical contract. Compression and memory studies should validate per-sequence semantics, gradients and hardware dispatch before treating acceptance or microtimings as a quality/cost gain.
selected_source_records.next_falsifiable_gate: Pin actual parent and candidate and run independent CUDA/Ascend valid and invalid inputs, empty/uneven segments, scalar/tensor offsets, partial/interleaved rotation, forward/backward, graph replay and compile. Then measure locked-hardware end-to-end callers with identical accepted inputs and quality/memory budgets; preserve earlier failed activation-cost/quality results.
